title: Outline as Two-Register Artifact
summary: Specifies the SYNTHESIS outline as a two-register artifact: an argumentative backbone (claims follow from evidence, framing does not overreach; verified by the argument audit) layered with a curatorial arrangement (selection, juxtaposition, scale shifts, the shimmer, personal voice; assessed by writer-and-agent judgment, with no formal verification mechanism). The backbone must hold even in lyric, hermit-crab, or indeterminate forms; the argument audit's scope is unchanged and continues to check only the logical register.
mechanism: two-register outline: argumentative backbone (argument-audited) plus curatorial arrangement (judgment-assessed)

links.note: adds structural specificity to what ADR-013's 'non-formulaic' outline means in practice; ADR-013's structure and citation/argument-audit requirements remain unchanged.
ADR-014's worth-the-calories tests primarily evaluate the argumentative register; curatorial quality is a separate, interacting concern.
curatorial-register judgment during the framing conversation is informed by ADR-028's structural experiments.
